messages.content: Solve the provided spatial task. Output exactly the candidate JSON schema. Never output tool actions or prose.

Native-asset active reconstruction C-L1-s0. View condition=active; fixed condition disables query_view. Reconstruct the live target using the same real asset instances shown in the attached catalogue atlas. Atlas staging is not the target: {"layout": {"table_green": {"position": [1.75, 1.75, 0], "yaw": 0}, "deskchair_black": {"position": [5.25, 1.75, 0], "yaw": 0}, "plant_pink": {"position": [1.75, 5.25, 0], "yaw": 0}, "crate_red": {"position": [5.25, 5.25, 0], "yaw": 0}}, "note": "Catalogue staging only, NOT target placements or sizes."}.
Fixed IDs, source materials and native proportions must remain. ID colour suffixes are opaque names. No deletion/replacement/new object. Sizes and permitted uncertainty={"table_green": {"size": [1.932, 1.027, 0.75], "size_range": [[1.545, 0.822, 0.6], [2.318, 1.232, 0.9]]}, "deskchair_black": {"size": [0.524, 0.491, 0.95], "size_range": [[0.419, 0.393, 0.76], [0.628, 0.59, 1.14]]}, "plant_pink": {"size": [0.259, 0.295, 0.8], "size_range": [[0.208, 0.236, 0.64], [0.311, 0.354, 0.96]]}, "crate_red": {"size": [0.5, 0.4, 0.4], "size_range": [[0.4, 0.32, 0.32], [0.6, 0.48, 0.48]]}}. Reconstructed size must use one uniform scale (nominal dimensions have 1mm rounding); height controls real mesh scale.
Frame: x right, y back, z up, metres; position=[centre_x,centre_y,bottom_z], finite coordinates within +/-100m; yaw=0/90/180/270 degrees. Room=[3.9, 3.0, 2.5].
Initial calibrated target views are attached after the catalogue. capture_reference obtains the actual reference. Then query_view(view) obtains one named public view; at most 1 distinct extra views. Cameras={"reference": {"eye": [1.95, -2.3483, 2.7547], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 0.35], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 320, "height": 240, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "front_left": {"eye": [-1.0605, -1.0261, 2.6189], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 0.35], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 320, "height": 240, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "front_right": {"eye": [4.9605, -1.0261, 2.6189], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 0.35], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 320, "height": 240, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "left": {"eye": [-2.1627, 1.5, 2.2678], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 0.35], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 320, "height": 240, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "right": {"eye": [6.0627, 1.5, 2.2678], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 0.35], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 320, "height": 240, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "top": {"eye": [1.95, 1.5, 8.9767], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 1, 0]}, "front": {"eye": [1.95, -6.2267, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "side": {"eye": [9.6767, 1.5, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}}. Images are real material meshes; no proxy-box input.
Source actions use restricted Python def build(public_params): ... returning COMPLETE {id:{position:[x,y,z],yaw:0,size:[x,y,z]}}. Only room is public_params. Imports, attribute/file/network/private-task access are forbidden.
Tools: {"tool":"inspect_asset","id":"instance"} gives an actual asset close-up at a public staging pose (no target information); {"tool":"capture_reference"}; {"tool":"query_view","view":"name"}; {"tool":"render","source":"...","view":"public name"} renders your candidate; {"tool":"compare","source":"..."} returns one mean actual-mesh silhouette IoU per acquired view only; {"tool":"submit","source":"..."} irrevocably executes the output. No hidden acceptance/retry signal.
All actual mesh physical/support/room rules must hold; projected footprint needs actual upward support surfaces within 1cm; unknown intersection is not a pass. Success additionally requires hidden-camera mean per-object visible silhouette IoU >=0.8 at 160x120 actual triangle rays AND every actual bounds centre within 0.05m of the target. Hidden cameras, target transforms and hidden score are evaluator-only. No dynamics/stability simulation.
Program contract: Exactly one build(public_params) function, 32KiB source/64KiB JSON output. Supported: literals, assignments, arithmetic, indexing, if/else, one-generator list comprehensions (<=100 items). No for/while loops, nested functions, imports, attributes, methods, files or network. Bare callable names: range, len, min, max, abs, round, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan2, sqrt, degrees, radians; pi is a fixed constant. Trigonometric inputs/outputs use radians except degrees/radians conversion. public_params contains room only.
Turn budget: 14 actions in total including submit.  Reply with exactly one JSON object per turn and nothing else. Only the first JSON object of a reply is executed; each observation tells you how many actions remain.
Current stage target observations={"stage_views": [{"view": "front", "camera": {"eye": [1.95, -6.2267, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "capture": {"scene_sha256": "768c0914c9168e8cacc29fd57c348c91550c3a535454a484c863d80571d0a78b", "renders": [{"file": "reference.png", "sha256": "03515c330d157b7567f7b2557fe56dd3b41a0211f03b3320a7e4b2603ddee9f5", "camera": {"eye": [1.95, -6.2267, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "raster_width": 640, "raster_height": 480}]}}, {"view": "side", "camera": {"eye": [9.6767, 1.5, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "capture": {"scene_sha256": "768c0914c9168e8cacc29fd57c348c91550c3a535454a484c863d80571d0a78b", "renders": [{"file": "reference.png", "sha256": "1855e0ea985138ceca245bde7ee85b8ec37811c801b2a4778bc9a9539527824f", "camera": {"eye": [9.6767, 1.5, 1.25], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 0, 1]}, "raster_width": 640, "raster_height": 480}]}}, {"view": "top", "camera": {"eye": [1.95, 1.5, 8.9767], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 1, 0]}, "capture": {"scene_sha256": "768c0914c9168e8cacc29fd57c348c91550c3a535454a484c863d80571d0a78b", "renders": [{"file": "reference.png", "sha256": "311e75e53b17e212e4c8293ffeddc4a0f00229b947417ae4ee81aec1e0e3490f", "camera": {"eye": [1.95, 1.5, 8.9767], "target": [1.95, 1.5, 1.25], "fov_deg": 50, "width": 640, "height": 480, "up": [0, 1, 0]}, "raster_width": 640, "raster_height": 480}]}}], "scope": "Actual current target RGB and public camera calibration only"}
After a target update, use newly supplied stage views to revise the preceding reconstruction. Preserve still-correct objects. Three perpendicular views are calibrated perspective images, not orthographic projections.
Syntax-scaffolded small-model experiment. Return only the candidate JSON matching the supplied schema, not a tool action and not Python. A trusted adapter will serialize your exact numeric proposal into build(public_params). It does not solve or repair your proposal. All task rules and physical requirements above still apply. For each object use height_m: its actual world height in metres, NOT a mesh scale factor. For example the nominal table world height is 0.75m, not its source-mesh scale. The adapter proportionally expands height into the public nominal width/depth. Infer TARGET placements from the attached target images; NEVER copy the catalogue staging layout. Use the public observations to solve the operation. For D include all home, pickup, release and onward waypoints, with command angles accounting for measured offsets.
